blocks.html: The S-Core Communication Framework provides zero-copy shared memory inter-process communication (IPC), service discovery, skeleton/proxy code generation, and SOME/IP bindings for high-throughput distributed automotive applications.

Communication Architecture & Key Requirements

Key requirements extracted from release pin v0.6.0:

Requirement IDCategorySafety / SecurityDescription
feat_req__com__zero_copy_ipcIPC / PerformanceASIL BGuarantees zero-copy shared memory data transfer for payloads larger than 4KB between local container instances.
feat_req__com__service_discoveryDiscoverySafety: QMImplements dynamic service registration and discovery over multicast UDP and local unix domain sockets.
feat_req__com__someip_bindingNetworkSecurity: YESProvides standardized SOME/IP protocol serialization and deserialization conforming to AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform specifications.
feat_req__com__e2e_protectionFunctional SafetyASIL DSupports end-to-end (E2E) CRC and alive counter verification profile 4/5/11 across communication streams.

Insgesamt 113 extrahierte Kommunikations-Anforderungen im S-Core Curation Review Portal.
